data.description: A trompe l'oeil retains all weapon proficiencies and natural weapons. If it's depicted wielding any manufactured weapons, the weapons are masterwork and gain a +%1 enhancement bonus (or equivalent weapon special abilities) when wielded by it. The bonus is based on its HD. A trompe l'oeil's weapons melt into puddles of nonmagical paint when the creature is destroyed.
